        for r in rows:

        break
# now test DOWN at col 0
def glyphs(L):
    S=[tuple(''.join(L[r][15+7*i:20+7*i]) for r in range(41,46)) for i in range(5)]
    P=[tuple(''.join(L[r][15+7*i:20+7*i]) for r in range(52,57)) for i in range(5)]
    return S,P
L0=current_frame.ascii.split('\n'); S0,P0=glyphs(L0)
action(['DOWN'])
L1=current_frame.ascii.split('\n'); S1,P1=glyphs(L1)
print('after DOWN: S changed:',[i for i in range(5) if S0[i]!=S1[i]],'P changed:',[i for i in range(5) if P0[i]!=P1[i]])
print('P0 now:',P1[0])

</function>
